description: This file defines the AdmonitionParser class, which is responsible for parsing admonition blocks in Markdown content, specifically handling custom admonition syntax with support for titles and indentation.

classes.name: AdmonitionParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling admonition blocks in Markdown, supporting custom types and titles, with indentation and block containment logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a specific admonition type and optional title.

methods.name: isContainer
methods.description: Indicates that this block can contain other blocks.

methods.name: canContain
methods.description: Determines if a child block can be contained within this block.

methods.name: tryContinue
methods.description: Determines if parsing should continue based on indentation or blank lines.

methods.name: blockStartParser
methods.description: Provides a parser for detecting the start of an admonition block based on specific syntax.

methods.name: parseInlines
methods.description: Parses inline content within the admonition, especially the title if present.
